prior_claim.paper_title: [Sample] AI tutoring in grade 8 mathematics: a 12-week RCT
prior_claim.text: AI tutoring raised grade 8 math test scores by 25% after 12 weeks.

quotes.text: After 12 weeks, students using the AI tutor scored 25% higher on the end-of-unit mathematics test than the control group (p < 0.01).
The effect was consistent across the four participating schools.

impacts.rationale: D measured retention rather than immediate gains, so it neither supports nor conflicts with C's finding about immediate gains by prior achievement.
